WITH f AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS all_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE f.net_amount END) AS nonstaff_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='ST' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS st_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) AS rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) AS rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1),
rt AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(x.refund_net) AS ret_net FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=x.store_key WHERE x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT f.store_id, round(f.all_net,2) AS all_net, round(f.nonstaff_net,2) AS nonstaff_net, round(r.rpt_gross,2) AS rpt_before_ret, round(r.rpt_ret,2) AS rpt_ret, round(rt.ret_net,2) AS fact_ret
FROM f LEFT JOIN r USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN rt USING(store_id) WHERE f.store_id IN (101,106,112,114,137,900,999) OR f.store_id<115 ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current),
sales AS (
  SELECT 'hist' AS basis, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net, f.standard_cost AS cost, 0::DECIMAL(14,2) AS ref, 0::DECIMAL(14,2) AS cost_ret
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region='South'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'hist', p.sku, 0, 0, r.refund_net, r.standard_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region='South'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'cur', p.sku, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost, 0, 0
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN cur c ON c.store_id=s.store_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND c.region='South'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'cur', p.sku, 0, 0, r.refund_net, r.standard_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN cur c ON c.store_id=s.store_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND c.region='South'
),
agg AS (SELECT basis, sku, sum(net-ref) AS net_sales, sum(net-cost) - sum(ref-cost_ret) AS gm, sum(net-cost) AS gm_before_ret FROM sales GROUP BY 1,2),
names AS (SELECT sku, arg_max(product_name, valid_from) AS product_name, arg_max(category, valid_from) AS category, count(*) AS versions FROM dim_product GROUP BY 1),
ranked AS (SELECT a.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY basis ORDER BY gm DESC) AS rk FROM agg a)
SELECT r.basis, r.rk, r.sku, n.product_name, n.category, n.versions, round(r.net_sales,2) AS net_sales, round(r.gm,2) AS gm, round(r.gm_before_ret,2) AS gm_before_ret
FROM ranked r JOIN names n USING(sku) WHERE r.rk<=12 ORDER BY basis, rk

WITH movements AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.net_amount AS sales_net, f.standard_cost AS sales_cost, 0::DECIMAL(14,2) AS refund_net, 0::DECIMAL(14,2) AS cost_returned
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region = 'South'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.sku, 0, 0, r.refund_net, r.standard_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region = 'South'
),
margin_by_sku AS (
  SELECT sku, sum(sales_net - refund_net) AS net_sales, sum(sales_net - sales_cost) - sum(refund_net - cost_returned) AS gross_margin FROM movements GROUP BY sku
),
names AS (SELECT sku, arg_max(product_name, valid_from) AS product_name FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY m.gross_margin DESC) AS rank, m.sku, n.product_name, round(m.gross_margin, 2) AS gross_margin_eur, round(100 * m.gross_margin / m.net_sales, 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM margin_by_sku m JOIN names n USING (sku) ORDER BY m.gross_margin DESC LIMIT 10
